title: Blue Swirl Bowls, Pair
description: Two bowls where cobalt blue and amber glazes run together in feathered bands. One centre curls into a tight spiral; the other breaks into rows of drips down the inside wall.
alt: Two bowls with feathered blue and amber glaze, one with a spiral at the centre

title: Bloom Bowls, Pair
description: A wide bowl and a smaller companion, each opening into a cream and pale blue flower that radiates out from the centre towards a soft grey-green rim.
alt: Two bowls with cream and pale blue petals radiating from the centre

title: Nesting Bowls, Set of Three
description: Three softly altered bowls that stack inside one another. Streaks of navy, sage and cream sweep up from each centre, and the speckled outer bowl holds the set together.
alt: Three nesting bowls with navy, sage and cream streaks inside a speckled cream outer bowl

title: Blue Sunflower Bowls, Pair
description: A deep bowl resting in a wide, shallow serving bowl, both in a mottled blue glaze with dark sunflower petals opening from a golden centre.
alt: A blue bowl sitting inside a wider shallow bowl, both decorated with a dark sunflower pattern

title: Twisted Wood Mugs and Creamer
description: Sea green and blue mugs with handles twisted like rope and branches that climb the sides, glazed a glossy dark brown. A matching creamer with a pulled spout completes the set.
alt: A stack of green and blue mugs and a creamer with twisted dark brown handles and branch decoration

title: Apple Mugs, Set of Four
description: Four round, apple-shaped mugs, each with a sculpted leaf at the rim and a stem for a handle. The glazes run from spring green to plum and deep blue, so every apple is a different variety.
alt: Four apple-shaped mugs in green, grey, blue and purple glazes, each with a leaf at the rim

title: Kisses Plate
description: A softly wavy plate covered in lipstick kisses in coral and blush pink, finished with a coral rim.
alt: A cream plate with a wavy edge covered in coral and pink lipstick kiss prints

title: Mountain Platter
description: A long rectangular platter on a clean white ground, with a snowy mountain range, a stand of pines and a small cabin drawn in fine black line along one edge.
alt: A long white rectangular platter with a black line drawing of mountains, pine trees and a cabin

title: Sugar Skull Plate
description: An oval plate crowded with ornate sugar skulls and roses in black and cream, edged in glossy black. Made for Halloween, fine for the rest of the year.
alt: An oval plate patterned with black and cream sugar skulls and roses, with a black rim

title: Chip and Dip, Green Drip
description: A chip and dip platter with the dip bowl built into the curve of the rim. A band of jade green glaze runs between the cream centre and a toasted, drippy edge.
alt: A cream chip and dip platter with a jade green band and a toasted drip-glazed rim and dip bowl

title: Chip and Dip, Midnight
description: The same chip and dip form in a glossy near-black glaze that clouds to smoky blue across the centre. The dip bowl rises out of the rim in a single curl.
alt: A glossy black and smoky blue chip and dip platter with the dip bowl rising from the rim

title: Leaf Candle Holder
description: A round holder carved through with rows of leaf-shaped openings. With a tea light inside, the leaves glow; the blue-grey glaze breaks to amber along every cut edge.
alt: A round blue-grey candle holder with carved leaf-shaped cut-outs edged in amber

title: Sunshine Sponge Holder and Dish
description: A sponge holder for the side of the sink and a matching square dish, both striped in soft blue with bright yellow suns. The kind of thing that makes washing up a little more cheerful.
alt: A blue-striped sponge holder with yellow suns holding a sponge, beside a matching square dish
